payload.summary: Approved direction from Jim (2026-07-28): dispatch passes task context through handoff DOCUMENTS, not giant prompts — mimic the handoff skill (~/.agents/skills/handoff/SKILL.md, Matt Pocock skills) inside the nahel workflow. Design sketch agreed: dispatcher writes nahel/runs/<run-id>/task.md (full brief); spawned prompt shrinks to a pointer (run nahel brief, read task.md, write result.md); worker writes nahel/runs/<run-id>/result.md; journal records PATHS not content. Adopt the skills four principles: (1) tailor the doc to what the next agent will do; (2) suggested-skills section -> nahel workflow pointers (brief, review-loop.md, tdd); (3) reference-dont-duplicate — point at items/PRDs/ADRs/git refs by id/path, never inline them (this is the prompt-size fix yolo-afk-dev needed); (4) redact secrets (consistent with ADR-0014 presence-not-value). Provenance caution: task.md is dispatcher-written content, not human-signed unless a human wrote it. Open questions for the grill: run-dir retention/cleanup; does dispatch itself write task.md or does the afk-run workflow; result.md format conventions; how review rounds chain documents. Grill before PRD.
